name: Bazett Fraga McRemitz
original_name: バゼット・フラガ・マクレミッツ
source:
A mage sent from the Mage's Association to fight the 5th War of the Holy Grail, born in Ireland as a descendant of old mage family of an unusual bloodline. She is mentioned very briefly in Fate/stay night. [spoiler]The original Master of [url=/c38]Lancer[/url], she was betrayed by [url=/c42]Kotomine Kirei[/url] and became the master of the Servant Avenger.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bazett_Fraga_McRemitz#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
